about: Figma source of truth for Game Core Style 2 (READY_UI_STYLE_2, id style-2): the Settings window. Read 2026-10-01 through the Figma MCP: read-only use_figma dumps and get_screenshot with contentsOnly (transparent renders). Coordinates are Figma units of the 1080 x 2344 screen frame = Ready UI design units; window boxes are local to the popup box (40, 647).
